0cacdf04aae4.en: Tier I (Cheap Goods): natural resources; paper and vellum.
0cacdf04aae4.t: Peringkat I (Barangan Murah): sumber semula jadi; kertas dan vellum.

1a2ed0c8f120.en: Where there's none: people burn animal-fat torches, though not usually inside homes. Gandew and Sundeath use more torches than anywhere else, because they're far from where fost stones are mined.
1a2ed0c8f120.t: Di mana tiada fost stone: orang membakar obor lemak haiwan, walaupun biasanya tidak di dalam rumah. Gandew dan Sundeath menggunakan lebih banyak obor daripada tempat lain, kerana mereka jauh dari tempat fost stone dilombong.

1adb8bc81b63.en: A custom-made weapon of chitin and finely crafted Bone Wood, with Winga beaks and claws for close-quarters combat (CQC). It works as a bow, but also as a melee weapon if needed.
1adb8bc81b63.t: Senjata tempahan daripada kitin dan Bone Wood yang dibuat halus, dengan paruh dan cakar Winga untuk pertempuran jarak dekat (CQC). Ia berfungsi sebagai busur, tetapi juga sebagai senjata jarak dekat jika perlu.

1e5106d75f3c.en: Wood ~10 Pearls; Bone Wood ~20 Pearls; chitin ~40 Pearls; iron ~85 Pearls; steel ~2 Amethysts; gold ~4 Aquamarines
1e5106d75f3c.t: Kayu ~10 Pearl; Bone Wood ~20 Pearl; kitin ~40 Pearl; besi ~85 Pearl; keluli ~2 Amethyst; emas ~4 Aquamarine

2504ce24727b.en: A Tier I worker (master level) saving half their pay needs, on average, about 450 working days for a full iron set, 660 for steel, 310 for Bone Wood, 260 for chitin and about 150 for Tibou or leather. See the Economy spreadsheet (Equipment Price Calculator).
2504ce24727b.t: Seorang pekerja Peringkat I (tahap mahir) yang menyimpan separuh gajinya memerlukan, secara purata, kira-kira 450 hari bekerja untuk set besi penuh, 660 untuk keluli, 310 untuk Bone Wood, 260 untuk kitin dan kira-kira 150 untuk Tibou atau kulit. Lihat hamparan Ekonomi (Equipment Price Calculator).

3033ea8c6184.en: Tier III (Expensive Goods): rare mineral resources (gold, titanium); higher-quality armor and weapons.
3033ea8c6184.t: Peringkat III (Barangan Mahal): sumber mineral jarang (emas, titanium); perisai dan senjata berkualiti tinggi.

31e653361e0e.en: Made of Soul Wood or Black Wood.
31e653361e0e.t: Diperbuat daripada Soul Wood atau Black Wood.

33a29dab963f.en: Ice Preserver (a fridge-freezer): made of wood and clay (~1 Amethyst), or iron, wood and clay (~1 Aquamarine).
33a29dab963f.t: Ice Preserver (peti sejuk beku): diperbuat daripada kayu dan tanah liat (~1 Amethyst), atau besi, kayu dan tanah liat (~1 Aquamarine).

39a8bd07a18b.en: Iron and steel cost the same everywhere except Tolerideme, where they're a little pricier. Bone Wood is cheapest in Freeish and Chitin in Gandew. See the Economy spreadsheet (Weapon & Household Price Calculator).
39a8bd07a18b.t: Besi dan keluli sama harga di mana-mana kecuali Tolerideme, di mana ia sedikit lebih mahal. Bone Wood paling murah di Freeish dan Kitin di Gandew. Lihat hamparan Ekonomi (Weapon & Household Price Calculator).

4424d0dd18ef.en: Charcoal, sometimes wrapped in wood to look fancy (see Kiko).
4424d0dd18ef.t: Arang, kadang-kadang dibalut kayu supaya nampak mewah (lihat Kiko).

4765bbc0170f.en: Used for: construction and furniture; decorating armor and weapons.
4765bbc0170f.t: Kegunaan: pembinaan dan perabot; menghias perisai dan senjata.

4fe8d925db58.en: A special chitin armor designed after the Sweet Sting, used for CQC and impaling. Morika once wore a Sweet Sting costume to gather Black Honey and liked how empowering it felt, so he saved for about a year and a half to have it made. It makes up for his slow reflexes and hides his face. He becomes another persona in it, The Stinger, and kills with the spike of his Stinger helmet.
4fe8d925db58.t: Perisai kitin khas yang direka berdasarkan Sweet Sting, digunakan untuk CQC dan menusuk. Morika pernah memakai kostum Sweet Sting untuk mengumpul Black Honey dan suka betapa memperkasakan rasanya, jadi dia menabung kira-kira setahun setengah untuk menempahnya. Ia menampung refleksnya yang lambat dan menyembunyikan wajahnya. Dia menjadi persona lain di dalamnya, The Stinger, dan membunuh dengan pancang topi keledar Stingernya.

51c64938ac53.en: The Tibou plant, with animal fat and other ingredients.
51c64938ac53.t: Tumbuhan Tibou, dengan lemak haiwan dan bahan lain.

5757b2155f92.en: What the materials alone cost, shipping included, in Pearls. The range runs from the cheapest region to the most expensive; crafting costs come on top.
5757b2155f92.t: Kos bahan sahaja, termasuk penghantaran, dalam Pearl. Julatnya dari wilayah termurah hingga termahal; kos pertukangan ditambah di atasnya.

59cb822763ff.en: 15 more entries on this page are only in <button class="linklike" data-go-bts>Behind The Scenes</button>.
59cb822763ff.t: 15 lagi entri di halaman ini hanya ada dalam <button class="linklike" data-go-bts>Di Sebalik Tabir</button>.

5ca532404946.en: Wine/Mead Mug: gotta be fancy. Wood ~13 Pearls; Bone Wood ~16 Pearls; chitin ~23 Pearls; iron ~29 Pearls; steel ~2 Amethysts; gold ~3 Aquamarines.
5ca532404946.t: Kole Wain/Mead: mesti bergaya. Kayu ~13 Pearl; Bone Wood ~16 Pearl; kitin ~23 Pearl; besi ~29 Pearl; keluli ~2 Amethyst; emas ~3 Aquamarine.

5e49b52715ce.en: A stone found in the sediment of the Buhraies lake, on the Buhraies Plains, and all the way from Waterfall City to the Sanbi Kingdom. Closer to the ocean, the riverbed lights up where the rocks get too close to salt water. Fauna, and beasts especially, seem to avoid places where it lies underwater.
5e49b52715ce.t: Batu yang ditemui dalam enapan tasik Buhraies, di Buhraies Plains, dan sepanjang jalan dari Waterfall City hingga Kerajaan Sanbi. Lebih dekat dengan lautan, dasar sungai bercahaya di mana batu terlalu dekat dengan air masin. Fauna, dan terutamanya makhluk buas, nampaknya mengelak tempat di mana ia berada di bawah air.

5f5a2affd95f.en: A plain piece of charcoal ~0–2 Pearls; a charcoal stick ~7 Pearls; a refined charcoal stick ~30 Pearls
5f5a2affd95f.t: Seketul arang biasa ~0–2 Pearl; batang arang ~7 Pearl; batang arang halus ~30 Pearl

635af13363af.en: Bread Plate/Bowl: made of bread (~0–2 Pearls). It soaks up the juices of your food, and is given to the poor afterward.
635af13363af.t: Pinggan/Mangkuk Roti: diperbuat daripada roti (~0–2 Pearl). Ia menyerap jus makanan kau, dan diberi kepada orang miskin selepas itu.

69f060ea9f2e.en: Usually iron or another metal that can withstand the water pressure. Pull it, and water flows from the pipe.
69f060ea9f2e.t: Biasanya besi atau logam lain yang boleh menahan tekanan air. Tariknya, dan air mengalir dari paip.

6acdd3ea77dc.en: Tier IV (Nobility Goods): custom armor and weapons; household items, or any item of extremely high craft or quality.
6acdd3ea77dc.t: Peringkat IV (Barangan Bangsawan): perisai dan senjata tempahan; barang rumah, atau apa-apa barang dengan ketukangan atau kualiti sangat tinggi.

6e97b1eafd0e.en: The materials and goods of Vraki, from natural resources like Fost Stone (a stone that lights up in salt water and keeps beasts away) and Bone Wood, to…
6e97b1eafd0e.t: Bahan dan barangan Vraki, daripada sumber asli seperti Fost Stone (batu yang bercahaya dalam air masin dan menjauhkan makhluk buas) dan Bone Wood, hingga…

7414e4da6d8b.en: Natural and Crafted Resources (World Lore illustration)
7414e4da6d8b.t: Sumber Semula Jadi dan Buatan (ilustrasi Lore Dunia)

756046544fb1.en: Summary written by AI from the author's notes (Natural and Crafted Resources.md). AI disclosure
756046544fb1.t: Ringkasan ditulis oleh AI daripada nota pengarang (Natural and Crafted Resources.md). Pendedahan AI

76478bf1274b.en: No switch: there's no "turning off the lights". To put one out, you pour out the water to stop the reaction.
76478bf1274b.t: Tiada suis: tiada “menutup lampu”. Untuk memadamkannya, kau tuang keluar air untuk menghentikan tindak balas.

7a1649119e6a.en: Picker: a two-pronged fork on one end and a spoon on the other. Each person commonly has their own and takes it with them; some decorate theirs or have their name carved on it to make it unique. Wood ~5 Pearls; Bone Wood ~10 Pearls; chitin ~17 Pearls; iron ~25 Pearls; steel ~1 Amethyst; gold ~1 Aquamarine.
7a1649119e6a.t: Picker: garpu dua mata di satu hujung dan sudu di hujung yang lain. Setiap orang biasanya ada sendiri dan membawanya ke mana-mana; ada yang menghias milik mereka atau mengukir nama padanya supaya unik. Kayu ~5 Pearl; Bone Wood ~10 Pearl; kitin ~17 Pearl; besi ~25 Pearl; keluli ~1 Amethyst; emas ~1 Aquamarine.

7d141a438f76.en: Used for: construction and furniture; armor; weapons.

7d6a8b1e4781.en: No candles: there are no candles in Vraki. Wax exists, but it's for sealing letters (like the Winga mail Forway provides).
7d6a8b1e4781.t: Tiada lilin: tiada lilin di Vraki. Lilin lebah wujud, tetapi untuk meterai surat (seperti mel Winga yang disediakan Forway).

7d8dcf0d9ced.t: Pedang panjang: besi ~1,464–1,644; keluli ~2,160–2,340; Bone Wood ~611–1,277; kitin ~396–1,116.

81e16785271f.en: The materials and goods of Vraki, from natural resources like Fost Stone (a stone that lights up in salt water and keeps beasts away) and Bone Wood, to weapons, armor and household items. Goods are sorted into four cost tiers by how expensive they are to move, from cheap goods like paper up to custom nobility pieces.
81e16785271f.t: Bahan dan barangan Vraki, daripada sumber asli seperti Fost Stone (batu yang bercahaya dalam air masin dan menjauhkan makhluk buas) dan Bone Wood, hingga senjata, perisai dan barang rumah. Barangan disusun kepada empat peringkat kos mengikut betapa mahalnya untuk dipindahkan, daripada barangan murah seperti kertas hingga barang tempahan bangsawan.

81ebd1383e1b.en: (slightly grainier)
81ebd1383e1b.t: (sedikit lebih berbutir)

8613e2c6eb2d.en: Tier II (Common Goods): expensive mineral resources (Nari stones, sapphires, aquamarines, amethysts); Black Honey; sigil rings; lower-quality armor and weapons; inks and dyes.
8613e2c6eb2d.t: Peringkat II (Barangan Biasa): sumber mineral mahal (batu Nari, sapphire, aquamarine, amethyst); Black Honey; cincin sigil; perisai dan senjata berkualiti rendah; dakwat dan pewarna.

86c7738b66fa.en: Wood, Bone Wood, chitin, iron, steel or gold
86c7738b66fa.t: Kayu, Bone Wood, kitin, besi, keluli atau emas

8fe87962b633.en: Sweet Sting wax and ink dye
8fe87962b633.t: Lilin Sweet Sting dan pewarna dakwat

91157d355643.en: Wood People wood is very durable, with a dark red color, and gives off a strong, woody musk when soaked (see Wood People).
91157d355643.t: Kayu Wood People sangat tahan lama, berwarna merah gelap, dan mengeluarkan bau musk kayu yang kuat apabila direndam (lihat Wood People).

92bf1c1e2196.en: Beer Mug: getting drunk requires the proper tools. Wood ~15 Pearls; Bone Wood ~20 Pearls; chitin ~28 Pearls; iron ~35 Pearls; steel ~3 Amethysts; gold ~5 Aquamarines.
92bf1c1e2196.t: Kole Bir: mabuk memerlukan alat yang betul. Kayu ~15 Pearl; Bone Wood ~20 Pearl; kitin ~28 Pearl; besi ~35 Pearl; keluli ~3 Amethyst; emas ~5 Aquamarine.

92fe15c90db7.en: The wood of the Soul Tree, a lone tree with metallic, shiny bark that grows around Blood City and Freeish (see Soul Tree). It's often used with nari stones, sigils and containers that hold Soul Energy, to keep the Soul Energy from leaking, and most badges are made of it (hence their greenish color). Its seeds give caffeine, and ground, they're basically the world's coffee.
92fe15c90db7.t: Kayu Soul Tree, pokok tunggal berkulit kayu berkilat seperti logam yang tumbuh di sekitar Blood City dan Freeish (lihat Soul Tree). Ia selalu digunakan dengan batu nari, sigil dan bekas yang menyimpan Tenaga Jiwa, untuk mengelak Tenaga Jiwa bocor, dan kebanyakan lencana diperbuat daripadanya (sebab itulah warnanya kehijauan). Bijinya memberi kafein, dan apabila dikisar, ia pada dasarnya kopi dunia itu.

937d89baf2b3.en: Plants mixed with salt and alcohol; some mix in wine, etc. A green syrup of mint, green tea and citrus that can numb your tongue if you use too much.
937d89baf2b3.t: Tumbuhan dicampur garam dan alkohol; ada yang mencampurkan wain dan lain-lain. Sirap hijau pudina, teh hijau dan sitrus yang boleh mengebaskan lidah kau kalau terlalu banyak digunakan.

9500b232835e.en: A full set of armor (helmet, chest, arms and legs), materials alone, shipping included, in Pearls, from the cheapest region to the most expensive:
9500b232835e.t: Satu set penuh perisai (topi keledar, dada, lengan dan kaki), bahan sahaja, termasuk penghantaran, dalam Pearl, dari wilayah termurah hingga termahal:

9e988d0ed278.en: When Fernan disappeared, so did his bow: his daughter Magi wants to find him, or at least his bow. Wilson Big-Gyut once tried to steal it and got punched for it, so he recreated it as closely as he could from memory.
9e988d0ed278.t: Apabila Fernan hilang, begitu juga busurnya: anak perempuannya Magi mahu mencarinya, atau sekurang-kurangnya busurnya. Wilson Big-Gyut pernah cuba mencurinya dan ditumbuk kerananya, jadi dia mencipta semula busur itu semirip mungkin berdasarkan ingatan.

aae8079e464c.en: The wood of the Black Sapphire Tree, a rare lone tree found between Flatland and Forway that looks dead and soaks up Soul Energy from its surroundings (see Black Sapphire Tree). Dark and dense, it keeps Soul Energy from leaking like no other wood, even better than Soul Wood; it's used with nari stones, sigils and Soul Energy containers to keep the Soul Energy from leaking. A single small or medium tree can cost a whole sapphire. Black wood badges are given to city officials, kingdom representatives and embassy representatives.
aae8079e464c.t: Kayu Black Sapphire Tree, pokok tunggal yang jarang ditemui antara Flatland dan Forway, yang kelihatan mati dan menyerap Tenaga Jiwa dari sekelilingnya (lihat Black Sapphire Tree). Gelap dan padat, ia menghalang Tenaga Jiwa daripada bocor seperti tiada kayu lain, malah lebih baik daripada Soul Wood; ia digunakan dengan batu nari, sigil dan bekas Tenaga Jiwa untuk mengelak Tenaga Jiwa bocor. Sepokok kecil atau sederhana boleh berharga sebiji sapphire. Lencana black wood diberikan kepada pegawai bandar, wakil kerajaan dan wakil kedutaan.

adbc3d28d91a.en: Why gems are Tier II: sapphires, aquamarines and amethysts are the currency, and from a shipping and handling perspective, currency is a common good. Security is what makes it special: only Forway moves large amounts of currency between cities and kingdoms, in heavily fortified wagons, and for the bandits salivating over those wagons, it's basically Tier IV.
adbc3d28d91a.t: Kenapa permata ialah Peringkat II: sapphire, aquamarine dan amethyst ialah mata wang, dan dari sudut penghantaran dan pengendalian, mata wang ialah barangan biasa. Keselamatanlah yang menjadikannya istimewa: hanya Forway yang memindahkan jumlah besar mata wang antara bandar dan kerajaan, dalam gerabak berkubu ketat, dan bagi penyamun yang meleleh air liur melihat gerabak itu, ia pada dasarnya Peringkat IV.

b163ade34cf8.en: Bagarisa fur and wood: a wooden toothbrush with stiff red bristles.
b163ade34cf8.t: Bulu Bagarisa dan kayu: berus gigi kayu dengan bulu merah yang keras.

b569f8e73d21.en: Winga beaks and claws, ground up with other beaks and claws. They all have to be strengthened by a Winga before they're removed, and the effect lasts for years before it starts to wear off (see Winga). Used to make tools that "cut through anything", since the dust makes them as hard as diamond: usually a coating is applied, then replaced every few years.
b569f8e73d21.t: Paruh dan cakar Winga, dikisar bersama paruh dan cakar lain. Semuanya mesti dikuatkan oleh seekor Winga sebelum dibuang, dan kesannya bertahan bertahun-tahun sebelum mula pudar (lihat Winga). Digunakan untuk membuat alat yang “memotong apa saja”, kerana debu itu menjadikannya sekeras berlian: biasanya salutan dikenakan, kemudian diganti setiap beberapa tahun.

bd7eac52298a.en: Soul Wood ~22–102 Pearls; Black Wood ~62–158 Pearls (materials and shipping)
bd7eac52298a.t: Soul Wood ~22–102 Pearl; Black Wood ~62–158 Pearl (bahan dan penghantaran)

c2f03233d800.en: Lapis lazuli, mined just like amethyst
c2f03233d800.t: Lapis lazuli, dilombong sama seperti amethyst

d4b2c60f333d.en: Black, fist-sized stones that form in the irradiated zones of Hifuna, with glowing colors inside that tell what powers they will likely grant. Whoever replaces their heart with one becomes undead, if they survive the binding. Forway has banned them. See Walking Heart Interface.
d4b2c60f333d.t: Batu hitam sebesar penumbuk yang terbentuk di zon teradiasi Hifuna, dengan warna bercahaya di dalamnya yang menunjukkan kuasa yang mungkin diberikannya. Sesiapa yang menggantikan jantungnya dengan satu menjadi mayat hidup, jika dia terselamat daripada pengikatan itu. Forway telah mengharamkannya. Lihat Antara Muka Walking Heart.

d5a4bf79be82.en: Source: Legacy/Behind The Scenes/World Lore/Natural and Crafted Resources.md
d5a4bf79be82.t: Sumber: Legacy/Behind The Scenes/World Lore/Natural and Crafted Resources.md

db530238cd9e.en: A fist-sized fost stone in a glass and wood case with an opening on top. In contact with salt water, it glows brighter than a candle would (candles aren't a thing in Vraki, and neither are oil lamps). The stone lasts about a year when used mostly at night. A big, new fost lamp is unusually bright (like a dentist's office) and can cost as much as a handful of amethysts, a steep price for common folk.
db530238cd9e.t: Fost stone sebesar penumbuk dalam bekas kaca dan kayu dengan bukaan di atas. Apabila bersentuhan dengan air masin, ia bercahaya lebih terang daripada lilin (lilin tidak wujud di Vraki, begitu juga pelita minyak). Batu itu tahan kira-kira setahun apabila digunakan kebanyakannya pada waktu malam. Lampu fost yang besar dan baharu luar biasa terang (seperti klinik doktor gigi) dan boleh berharga segenggam amethyst, harga yang mahal bagi orang biasa.

e7a3fffa3295.en: Goods are sorted into four tiers, which set how much it costs to ship them (see Economy).
e7a3fffa3295.t: Barangan diisih kepada empat peringkat, yang menetapkan berapa kos menghantarnya (lihat Ekonomi).

f596d7e234c5.en: A mixture of bone, iron, ground Nari and Greenbread fruit core. Less flexible than most wood, but it lasts much longer, and mixed with other materials, it can be made more flexible for armor and weapons.
f596d7e234c5.t: Campuran tulang, besi, Nari yang dikisar dan teras buah Greenbread. Kurang anjal daripada kebanyakan kayu, tetapi ia tahan jauh lebih lama, dan apabila dicampur dengan bahan lain, ia boleh dibuat lebih anjal untuk perisai dan senjata.

fb764acb28a3.en: Light source: it needs water and salt to work. There's no wick, flame or smoke; the hissing a lit fost stone makes is the water and salt reacting with the stone, which gives off light and steam.
fb764acb28a3.t: Sumber cahaya: ia memerlukan air dan garam untuk berfungsi. Tiada sumbu, api atau asap; desisan yang dibuat fost stone yang menyala ialah air dan garam bertindak balas dengan batu itu, yang mengeluarkan cahaya dan wap.
